plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3 as in the parent. Feed a 20-input circuit from the 26 inputs: x0..x4, the lines other than y9, then y3 OR y5, y6 OR y10, and the OR of those four lines. For every AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two on those 20 inputs, some such circuit on the 26 inputs with at most 40 more gates computes the incidence of the points 5 to 12 OR the first circuit fed that way.
